cases.why: sshd is deliberately NOT wired. Nearly every line it writes carries no level of its own (`Invalid user ...`, `Accepted publickey ...`), and the one that does is this: 704 a day on kelpy, all from internet scanners, about the REMOTE client's algorithm choice rather than anything about our host. Promoting it would add 704 unactionable warnings and nothing else.
